Describe the user-visible change and how to verify it.

<!-- For a UI change, read DESIGN.md first and complete the following review.
Other PRs can remove this section. -->
- Reference screenshot and five observations (palette, typography, spacing, components, layout)
- Desktop 1440 and mobile 390 before / after screenshots
- Independent screenshot review rounds (score, specific findings, changes, outstanding items)
- Elements removed and AI-pattern checklist from DESIGN.md
- Film sources and any missing shots
- Keyboard, reduced motion, overflow, Lighthouse and build / lint / typecheck
